headline: PONG plays like the 1972 cabinet now
lede: The port's two invented dice — post-point paddle scatter and random hit spin — are gone. Deflection comes from where the ball strikes the paddle, paddles hold position across points, and every proof re-baselined honestly at the new table: the driver sweeps 40/40 and seed 25's legendary forced loss fell off with the scatter.

notes.text: Strike-position deflection replaces the spin die (edge hits steepen, center flattens, dice only ever roll at serve — pongcheck counts them and pins it at two).

Two latent bugs found en route: the unguarded wall-flip parked the ball above the ceiling once kicks became deterministic (direction-guarded flip now, penetration kept), and flat-return convergence deadlocked the capped EASY table (dice-free |dy| floor).

The WATCH driver learned the new law: it now aims off-center at the far wall — HARD recovers from a collapsed 26/40 to 38/40 (seeds 14+24 named), NORMAL wins all 40 conceding 15, EASY 40/40 with zero concessions.
Pins moved because the game did: tier sweeps re-measured, the #3502 bit-trace re-baselined at the corrected NORMAL, 7 new mutants anchored on the replaced lines, all 25 mutants die.
